task: Deepen (flagship 6) shift-roster-builder: whether a repair reserve pays at 20-60 people

deviations.why: The flagship item asked whether a repair reserve pays at 20-60 people; the measurement answered no (every build already at its proven floor), which alone would be a negative result only.
deviations.did: Used the same data to find and fix the waste it exposed: the repair ran on rosters already at a proven floor. Skipped it there, measured on the 15 affected bench builds and 60 small weeks.
deviations.result: Same rosters, 1.31 s a build back on the 15 builds; 663 venture tests pass.

deviations.why: 20 x 56 weeks left out of the 20-60 bench
deviations.result: 20-person weeks prove in about a second (README 'The exact check end to end'), so a reserve has nothing to act on there.

notes: Bench: 108 builds (30/40/50/60 people x weeks 0-2 x seeds 4-6 x reserve 0/500/2000 ms), all 36 per setting at the proven floor, 7,575 open h each, 0 repair gains. Fix: skip coverRepair when unfilled <= ctx.openFloor (default repair only, default tie-break). Rebuilt 15 builds: same open hours 15/15, 261.0 -> 241.4 s. 60 small weeks: identical open hours, open shifts, score and pay. Verification: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder -> ok (250.2s, 663 tests); node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs shift-roster-builder -> preflight clean. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README section carries the next step and the flagship next: was updated.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer designing and running a 108-build benchmark, then a guarded skip, tests and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
